capabilities: Run commands with recent choices ranked first
Open and create files from the same input using /
Filter file search by tags using #
Chain commands into macros with configurable delays
Hide and reveal less useful commands, files, and tags
extras: Pinned commands from the default Command Palette carry over. Some features are marked 'Coming Soon' (recent query population, frontmatter content search).
intentEvidence: adds a command palatte that is more user friendly and more feature rich
problem: The default command palette only lists commands, so opening files, finding tagged notes, or repeating command sequences requires other hotkeys and tools.
summary: Replacement command palette that ranks recent choices, opens and creates files, searches files by tag, and runs chained macro commands.
